spec.description: Fetch one of the site's ranked lists, as an ordered array of item ids.

feed.description: The list to fetch. `topstories` is the front page, `newstories` the newest submissions, `beststories` the highest-scoring recent ones, and the last three are the site's Ask HN, Show HN and jobs pages.

response.description: Item ids in the list's own rank order, best or newest first. Up to 500 for `topstories`, `newstories` and `beststories`; up to 200 for the other three.

items.description: One item id; fetch it with `items.get`.

notes: Six documented endpoints, one operation: the six paths differ only by the file name, and every one answers the same array of ids. So `feed` is a request parameter substituted into the path, and the six names are its `enum`, rather than six near-identical endpoint directories.
The response is a bare array, not an object wrapping one. There is nothing to unwrap and no envelope to declare; the generated method returns the list itself.
